title: revealjs-html-links
text:
This extension adds a persistent “Webpage version” button to RevealJS presentations that links back to the corresponding HTML notes document.
Use quarto add d-morrison/revealjs-html-links in your Quarto project, then enable the filter:
filters:
  - d-morrison/revealjs-html-links
See example.qmd for a minimal working example.
